meta.title: Marswalk Surface Ops (working title)
meta.disclaimer: Marswalk Surface Ops is an exploratory hackathon prototype. It is not astronaut operations software. Crew, suit, rover and vehicle states are simulated. Solar events are real historical records replayed on a simulated clock — not a live feed from Mars. Slope limits, speeds, consumables and shelter values are illustrative assumptions from Earth and Apollo-era references. Radio coverage is line-of-sight only.

interactions: Press and hold 800 ms; a progress line runs along the chamfered edge; releasing early cancels ("Released early — hold 0.8 s"); on completion a 300 ms outcome state ("PR1 dispatched — ETA 14 min") then the command is issued. Keyboard: hold Enter/Space. Accessibility fallback (toggle): tap, then a Confirm button replaces it for 5 s.

One bar slot, highest level wins, "+N" counter opens the alert list. Warning flashes twice (2 Hz, < 3 Hz) then holds; caution pulses once; advisory auto-dismisses after 10 s and stays in the log. Acknowledge silences and marks seen; it does not clear the condition; warnings and cautions latch until acknowledged and cleared.

With no active alert the 64 px alert slot on the EVA tablet shows STATUS plus a word: NOMINAL (nominal icon), STANDBY or EVA ENDED (advisory icon), with a detail text and the current EVA phase on the right (portrait: word and phase only). The alert bar replaces it in the same slot when an alert is raised and the line returns when the alert is acknowledged and cleared. It is not a live region, so it never announces itself. Ops and HUD keep the slot empty.
One alert store drives ops, EVA and HUD; the Stage page reads the text from each frame and shows IDENTICAL or DIFFER.

Values older than 5 s turn text-3 with an age stamp. Unlinked: EVA shows the caution bar "No hab link — operating on cached plan"; ops shows the crew card dashed with last-known values and age; commands show "Queued — sends when link returns" and are resent on reconnection.
Tap and hold anywhere for 2 s; a thin progress line appears at the bottom edge; release cancels.
Switches the EVA frame to the HUD palette; alert bars become outlined (DV-05).
Toggle with a visible SOUND OFF / SOUND ON indicator; warning two-tone repeats every 5 s until acknowledged; vibration pattern 3 × 200 ms where the Vibration API exists.
Space pause · 1/2/3 speed · N next event · K acknowledge · O focus options.

A add-stop mode · Enter place at crosshair · Delete remove selected · B briefing · ? sources · arrows pan · +/− zoom. Drag stops; on drop validate → snap offer (≤ 50 m) or refuse; max two scientific overlays (a third dims the oldest and says so); inputs recompute after a 300 ms debounce and an invalid value is never sent.

Beats hold between keyframes; markers tween visually only; 60× plays at the pace of the recorded table, 10× and 1× are slower; next event, previous, scrub. Commands from the Stage (hold Summon) advance the replay.

Rows are at least 56 px with a neutral check box, the task text and SKIP. One tap marks DONE or SKIPPED (no hold-to-confirm: not a safety action) and opens a 5-s undo strip with a shrinking bar (no number); the REASON control cycles time → terrain → alert → other. Without a hab link the change is queued and marked NOT SYNCED in the row and the strip, and clears when the link returns. Ops can add a task (ops-added rows list first, tagged ADDED BY OPS). Open tasks become DROPPED when a plan revision cuts the stop. During an alert the list collapses to a non-interactive count. Counts are looked up, never computed.

Tap the mini-map or press FULL. In landscape HAVEN and O₂ stack at the left as smaller cards and the map takes at least 80 % of the width; in portrait the cards stay in their row. The alert slot, strip and action row do not move. Buttons: +, −, FIT, FOLLOW, LAYERS, CLOSE. Extras: drag to pan, wheel or pinch to zoom. Layers: slope, thermal inertia, comm shadow, haven bands (at most two scientific overlays; a third turns the oldest off and says so). A warning closes the full map. The planner has + / − buttons, drag and wheel; ops has + / − / FIT, drag, wheel, and Slope and Thermal inertia toggles.
a11y: Contrast: BRIEF/OPS text ≥ 4.5 : 1, non-text ≥ 3 : 1, HUD ≥ 7 : 1; the Design system page computes every pair live and compares it with the 04 §C.1 value.
The EVA status line is a status like any other: nominal icon (circle with check), the word NOMINAL, and the fixed alert slot; it is not an aria-live region so nothing is announced while it is idle.
Four cues per status: colour + shape + word + fixed slot. The Grayscale toggle applies a grayscale filter and the badge counts statuses that have all four cues.
Focus: white 2 px ring with a 2 px void gap on every control; chamfered controls draw the ring on a wrapper because clip-path clips outlines.
Targets: EVA ≥ 56 px with ≥ 8 px gaps (measured in Chromium for all 32 EVA state × device combinations); ops mouse ≥ 32 px.
Live regions: warnings role=alert + aria-live=assertive; cautions and advisories role=status + polite; crew cards and options are lists with full text.
No hamburger menus, no hover-only actions, no gesture-only paths in OPS/EVA; hidden content shows a count (alert "+N", log "n / m").
Reduced motion: no flashes (static bar) and no marker interpolation; animations and transitions are disabled.
Never colour alone for focus, selection or current step (P10): ring + outline + marker + label.

Task rows are at least 56 px; each check box is a button with a label such as "Mark done: Observe the sulfate ledge face"; the undo strip is a status region; task state never uses a status colour, so it reads in grayscale (shape + word).

Map: buttons are the primary path and every control has a word (icon + word on EVA); drag, wheel and pinch are extras; the planner keeps its keyboard keys (arrows pan, +/− zoom). The Add task button carries aria-disabled and it is kept in step with the field.
